{{Quote|Dantooine. They're on Dantooine.|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]|<ref name="ANH" />}}
This '''Dantooine base''' was one of the the first bases used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] after the signing of the [[Corellian Treaty]] in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] and was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. Safely evacuated prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], it was later reused but intended only to be a temporary base for the Alliance.

==History==
===The Rebel base===
{{Quote|An old Rebel base can be found in the northwest corner of Dantooine. It was supposedly abandoned when the traitors making up the Rebel Alliance opted for a new and, one would assume, better base of operations. My belief is that there are still Rebels making use of the base. Maybe not many, but some.|[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Sabol]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:LS">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other|Corellian Corvette Pre-Quest: "Lt. Sabol"}}</ref>}}
The Rebel base on Dantooine was established early during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was used as the primary headquarters of the [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]] after the [[Orion IV Rebel base|base]] on [[Orion IV]] was [[Battle of Orion IV|abandoned]]<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> during [[Operation Strike Fear]] in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].<ref name="Xwing_1BBY">{{Xwing_1BBY}}</ref> In order to protect the facility, a less concealed [[Dantooine decoy base|decoy base]] was built on the other side of the planet Dantooine to lure the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] away.<ref name="SWG:CA">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=conversation|Captain Ackbar|Dantooine}}</ref> The Rebel headquarters on Dantooine was commanded by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Dodonna]].<ref name="TNEC" /> Units assigned to the base at that time included [[Dantooine Squadron]], a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] led by [[Garven Dreis/Legends|Garven Dreis]],<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> and a [[BTL-A4 Y-wing assault starfighter/bomber|Y-wing]] squadron commanded by [[Davish Krail]].<ref name="CCG-Gold3">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=Gold 3}}</ref> Other Rebel personnel stationed at the base included [[Tigran Jamiro/Legends|Tigran Jamiro]]<ref name="SWE">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> and [[Ryle Torsyn/Legends|Ryle Torsyn]].<ref name="CCG-Gold3" />

The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Drakka Judarrl]], a survivor to the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]], came to hid on Dantooine after she discovered the establishment of the Rebel base on the planet. She then organized raids against the Empire with the help of the local [[Dantari]].<ref name="SWG:DJ">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=static|Drakka Judarrl|Dantooine}}</ref>

[[File:Abandoned-rebel-base---leia.jpg|thumb|left|250px|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]] in the base]]
In 1 BBY, the Alliance planned to hold [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] hostage here, after he had been [[Assault on Kamino|captured]] on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], unaware that [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] was pursuing the Rebels and their valuable hostage in [[Slave I/Legends|his ship]].<ref name="TFUII">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''</ref>

At the time of the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|Destruction of Alderaan]], in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] revealed Dantooine base's existence to the Empire when she was captured.<ref name="ANH" /> Fortunately, the Imperial survey team soon only found the decoy base on the other side of the planet<ref name="SWG:CA" /> and confirmed that it had been abandoned and was not the current Rebel base as she had claimed.<ref name="ANH" /> However, before long, just prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Alliance really abandoned its base on Dantooine<ref name="TNEC" /> when Ryle Torsyn of [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gold Squadron]] discovered an Imperial [[Homing beacon/Legends|tracking device]]<ref name="CCG-RyleTorsyn">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=Ryle Torsyn}}</ref> in the cargo of a [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] docking there.<ref name="TRoD">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: The Ruins of Dantooine]]''</ref> As a result, all personnel was evacuated in one day's time<ref name="SWE" /> and was relocated to the [[Great Temple/Legends|Great Temple]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="TNEC" /> The Rebel agents [[Dusque Mistflier]] and [[Finn Darktrin]] would later be send to the abandoned base to recover a [[Datacron/Legends|datacron]] containing sensitive information about Rebel sympathizers that was lost during the evacuation.<ref name="TRoD" />

[[File:Abandoned-rebel-base-hall.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Vortex Squadron officers in the base after the Battle of Yavin]]
Eventually, the discovery of the decoy base by the Empire allowed the real Rebel base to not be compromised. After the Battle of Yavin, the Rebel Alliance was in search for a permanent base. As the Empire considered the Rebellion had abandoned Dantooine, the Rebels were able to return safely to Dantooine and reuse their abandoned base as an emergency base.<ref name="SWG:CA" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] and [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]] temporary settled in the base, where they both employed loyal [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] to fulfill a number of missions and tasks against the Empire.<ref name="SWG:RTP">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other|Rebel Theme Park}}</ref> [[Vortex Squadron]] also used the base as its headquarters during the same period of time.<ref name="SWG:JtL">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''</ref> Around the same time, an Imperial agent working for [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Sabol]] finally discovered and explored the Rebel base on Dantooine while seeking documents containing information about the location of a high-ranking Rebel officer that the Empire wanted assassinated.<ref name="SWG:LS" />

===Later history===
{{Quote|I was just showing Gantoris some images of Dantooine. We are considering moving the refugees from Eol Sha to our old base there.|Leia Organa Solo|<ref name="JS" />}}
In [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], the base was used by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] to relocate refugees from [[Eol Sha]].<ref name="JS" /> However, the [[Eol Sha Colony|colony]] was soon completely [[Attack on Dantooine (Galactic Civil War)|destroyed]] by Imperial Admiral [[Natasi Daala]].<ref name="DA" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|We have re-established this emergency base after the Empire located our decoy base on the other side of Dantooine.|[[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]], about the Rebel bases on Dantooine|<ref name="SWG:CA" />}}
This Rebel base on Dantooine was first mentioned in the movie {{Film|IV}}.<ref name="ANH" /> The base later appeared or was mentioned in several ''Star Wars'' media, including novels, source books and video game.<ref name="DA" /><ref name="TNEC" /><ref name="TFUII" /> Eventually, the video game ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' established that the Rebel base discovered by the Empire on Dantooine in ''A New Hope'' was in fact not the real base but a decoy intended to lure the Empire away, justifying the use of the Dantooine base in the game.<ref name="SWG:CA" />
